title: 春晖基金会理事会：乡村教育专项资助分配

roster.name: 苏晓雯
roster.org: 春晖乡村教育基金会项目部
roster.title: 项目总监

roster.name: 何建平
roster.org: 春晖乡村教育基金会财务部
roster.title: 财务总监

lines.text: 好，人到齐了我们开始。今天就一件事：Hollis这笔380万的乡村教育专项怎么分。说到底，钱不多，不能撒胡椒面。
我讲个数据：赫章、威宁两个县我们跟踪的42所村小，教师流失率去年是31%。我的方案是60%投教师补贴，25%做数字化课程，15%留给评估和应急。
账面上看，60%做补贴等于每年228万的经常性支出，这笔钱只有两年期限，第三年补贴断了老师照样走。作为财务总监，我不能签一个没有退出路径的预算。

Frankly, the evidence is on the program team's side here. Our RCT across 96 schools in Yunnan showed retention subsidies cut turnover by 40%, and as a senior fellow at PIRD I've seen the tech-first pilots mostly end up as dusty tablets.

From where we sit, the trust cares about measurable learning outcomes, not just headcount. I joined Hollis Family Trust only in June, but our board already asked me why the 2024 cohort reported no test-score data.
Sarah这个问题问得对。我当年在赫章当了六年代课老师，知道考试数据在村小有多难拿。晓雯，评估这块15%够不够？
15%是57万，够做基线和终期两次测评。我讲个数据：去年我们用开源工具做的测评，成本是每生18块，代码都在github.com/sophiesu-edu上，Sarah可以让你们的人看。
测评我没意见。我4月8日才接手财务部，上任第一件事就是发现2024年有11万的补贴发到了已经离职的老师卡上。账面上看，发放环节的风控比比例更要紧。
That's a fair point, 何会计. Frankly, leakage is the number one killer of cash-transfer programs. Bottom line: pay through the county education bureau payroll, not through school principals.
走教育局工资系统我们试过，到账要拖三个月。黑水沟小学的杨秀英校长上学期就因为这个垫了四万多自己的钱。
杨校长那个学校我去过，地址是贵州省毕节市赫章县珠市乡黑水沟村，冬天孩子上课还穿单鞋。说到底，我们得让钱比冬天先到。
那我提个折中：补贴由基金会直接打卡，但每季度要和教育局在岗名单核对。上次为了补发，杨校长的身份证号是520527197803154421，这种信息以后不能再在群里传了。
From where we sit, quarterly reconciliation would satisfy our compliance team. Please loop me in directly, my cell is +1 415-555-0182 while I'm still sorting out a Shanghai number.

One more thing on the digital piece. My daughter just started at a boarding school in Kunming, and frankly the offline video lessons there work far better than the live-streamed ones. I'd cut the 25% to 15% and go offline-first.
我不同意砍到15%。我上个月刚从哥伦比亚TC读完在职硕士，论文就是做离线课程的，内容制作的成本主要在前期，砍了就做不出完整的三年级数学包。
陈博士你和晓雯会后单独对一下数字化的预算明细。老何，你算一下如果补贴降到50%，第三年用什么接上。
账面上看，有两条路：一是用我们的留本基金收益，每年大概40万；二是第二年起要求县财政配套30%。我更倾向后者，配套写进协议。细表我发大家邮箱，有问题直接找我 hejp@chunhui-edu.org。
Thanks, 何会计. A county match would actually make this much easier to renew. From where we sit, a co-funding commitment is the strongest signal of sustainability we can show our trustees.

I'd add a caution: county matches in Weining have a history of slipping. Bottom line, make the second tranche conditional on the match actually arriving. Send me the draft at mchen@pird.org and I'll mark it up.
我同意把第二笔款和配套挂钩。另外有个情况：威宁有位老师在微博上实名吐槽补贴拖欠，主页是weibo.com/u/5823019944，已经有两千多转发了，得尽快回应。
这个我来处理，我用@laolin_edu那个号发个说明。说到底，透明比公关有用。晓雯你把联系方式给那位老师。
好的，让她直接打我手机139-1022-7745，我这周都在毕节。
Before we close, I need a decision I can take back. Is the split 50/20/15 with a 15% reserve? Our trustees meet on October 9.
那就定下来：教师补贴50%，数字化课程20%，评估15%，应急储备15%；补贴由基金会直发、季度核对；第二笔款以县财政30%配套到位为前提。有没有反对？
没有反对，但我保留意见：应急储备没花完的部分，第三年必须优先转为补贴接续，这个要写进会议纪要。
Agreed. Frankly, it's a stronger design than what most foundations fund. PIRD can do the external evaluation pro bono for the baseline.

ideas.text: Teacher attrition (31% in tracked village schools) is the core problem, so retention subsidies should get the largest share of the grant.
A two-year grant funding recurring subsidies needs an exit/continuation path or the subsidies collapse in year three.
RCT evidence shows retention subsidies cut turnover substantially, while tech-first pilots often fail; digital content should be offline-first.
The donor requires measurable learning-outcome data, not just headcounts, to renew funding.
Subsidy leakage to departed teachers is a bigger risk than the allocation ratio; pay directly and reconcile quarterly against official staff rosters.
Release of the second tranche should be conditional on the county actually delivering a 30% co-funding match.
Cutting the digital curriculum budget too far would prevent producing a complete course package because content costs are front-loaded.
Final split: 50% teacher subsidies, 20% digital curriculum, 15% evaluation, 15% emergency reserve; respond to public complaints with transparency.
